controls.risk: Incomplete P&L data could cause reported results to misstate actual financial performance.
controls.control_activity: All P&L line items are present for all 12 months in actuals
controls.detail: 84 of 84 expected (month x line_item) cells present.
controls.exception_remediation: None required — control operating as designed.

controls.risk: An incomplete budget load would produce false or missing variance results for any affected line.
controls.control_activity: All P&L line items are present for all 12 months in budgets
controls.exception_remediation: None required — control operating as designed.

controls.risk: An incomplete forecast load would misstate forecast-accuracy reporting.
controls.control_activity: All P&L line items are present for all 12 months in forecasts
controls.exception_remediation: None required — control operating as designed.

controls.risk: A missing units-sold record would break per-unit KPI reporting for that month.
controls.control_activity: A units-sold record exists for every closed month
controls.detail: 12 of 12 expected monthly units_sold records present.
controls.exception_remediation: None required — control operating as designed.

controls.risk: A broken waterfall reconciliation would let a mis-stated variance narrative reach management undetected.
controls.control_activity: Operating Income waterfall reconciles exactly to the total OI variance
controls.detail: Waterfall reconciles to OI variance for all 12 months (difference = $0.00).
controls.exception_remediation: None required — control operating as designed.

controls.risk: A mismatch between booked revenue and shipment volume could indicate a pricing or booking error.
controls.control_activity: Implied unit price (Revenue / units sold) falls within expected range
controls.detail: Implied unit price within $38-$47 for all 12 months.
controls.exception_remediation: None required — control operating as designed.

controls.risk: An unexplained COGS ratio swing could indicate a supplier cost issue or margin erosion going unnoticed until year-end.
controls.control_activity: Exception if COGS as a % of Revenue exceeds Budget or the latest Forecast by more than 200 bps
controls.evidence_ref: COGS trend analysis workpaper (Actual/Budget/Forecast COGS-%-of-Revenue, bps variance). Result: 2025-12: Actual COGS was 57.91% of Revenue (Budget 55.50%, Forecast 63.09%). Actual COGS exceeded Budget by 241 bps (+241 bps), which triggered the exception (threshold: +200 bps). Actual was 518 bps below Forecast (-518 bps), which is favorable and not the trigger.
controls.detail: 2025-12: Actual COGS was 57.91% of Revenue (Budget 55.50%, Forecast 63.09%). Actual COGS exceeded Budget by 241 bps (+241 bps), which triggered the exception (threshold: +200 bps). Actual was 518 bps below Forecast (-518 bps), which is favorable and not the trigger.
controls.exception_remediation: Research root cause with Supply Chain/Procurement; document business justification for the period and evaluate whether standard cost assumptions need revision for the next forecast cycle.

controls.risk: A forecast copy-forwarded from budget rather than re-based on actuals would overstate forecast accuracy and mislead planning.
controls.control_activity: Forecast values are re-based (not copy-forwarded) after each quarterly revision
controls.evidence_ref: Forecast vintage comparison — forecasts vs. budgets table
controls.detail: All post-Q1 forecasts were re-based off actual run-rate (no stale budget copy-forward).
controls.exception_remediation: None required — control operating as designed.

controls.risk: An unapproved budget could be used as the basis for variance reporting without management's agreement to the plan.
controls.control_activity: Annual budget is signed off by the Finance Director before fiscal-year start
controls.detail: Manual attestation — no automated data trail in this model.
controls.exception_remediation: None required — control operating as designed.

controls.risk: An unreviewed large journal entry could post an error or an unauthorized adjustment to the GL.
controls.control_activity: Journal entries and reclasses over $25,000 require a second approver
controls.evidence_ref: JE approval workflow log (second-approver field populated)
controls.detail: Manual attestation — no automated data trail in this model.
controls.exception_remediation: None required — control operating as designed.

controls.risk: An unapproved forecast revision could reach leadership without FP&A management review.
controls.control_activity: Quarterly forecast revisions are approved by the FP&A Manager before publication
controls.detail: Manual attestation — no automated data trail in this model.
controls.exception_remediation: None required — control operating as designed.

controls.risk: Unrestricted access to the close-the-books function could allow an unauthorized user to alter a closed period.
controls.control_activity: Close-the-books system function is restricted to the Controller and Assistant Controller
controls.evidence_ref: System access review: close-lock role membership
controls.detail: Manual attestation — no automated data trail in this model.
controls.exception_remediation: None required — control operating as designed.
